can_execute.quote: Set the dates once and Predis.ai publishes to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube on schedule,
can_execute.note: Opening of a longer sentence, confirmed on a second read. True for social posting only; for paid ads the site keeps the launch and budget with the user. An approval step exists: 'Send a draft for review, and nothing goes out until someone approves it.'

multi_agent.note: No agent wording. The homepage says 'We orchestrate them', but about AI models, not agents.

evidence.quote: Autoposting publishes to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube on the dates you set,

integrations.note: There is no integrations page; names are gathered from three pages. The site's own lists disagree with each other (YouTube and Google My Business each appear in only some of them).

pricing.quote: Every plan starts with 3 days free.
pricing.note: Core plan is written '$19 /month' with a struck-through '$32' and '$230 Billed Yearly'. free_tier is true because of a 3-day card-required trial, not a free plan.

hq_location.note: Stated only on the site's /llm-info/ page ('Predis.ai Official Facts'), which a crawler following normal navigation may never reach. The terms page gives the legal name 'EZML Technologies Pvt Ltd.' and Maharashtra (India) law, but no address.

notes: The reading tool saw '[email protected]' in place of the support address. That placeholder is what Cloudflare's email obfuscation produces, so the site is probably served through Cloudflare (an inference, not something the site states). Positioned as an AI ad generator rather than an agent.
